howToApply: Register on the NATS 2.0 web portal at www.nats.education.gov.in and obtain a Registration Number by filling required fields and uploading certificate copies.

Enter all required information and upload a recent photo (JPEG format, 10KB–50KB, 3.5cm x 4.5cm with signature at bottom) along with the following original certificates in PDF format (50KB–250KB): SSC Certificate, Graduate/Diploma Certificate (Provisional Certificate & Consolidated Marks Memo), Reservation Certificate (if applicable), SCCL Employee/Ex-Employee Children documents (if applicable), PDF/PAF Certificate (if applicable).

Submit the duly signed portal-generated application printout along with NATS 2.0 registration form, certificate copies (Provisional Certificate & Consolidated Marks Memo), and UBI bank account first page at the nearest Area GVTC/MVTC from 06.08.2026 12PM to 16.08.2026 5PM.
Opt into the Union Bank of India Rs.30 Lakhs Group Accidental Insurance Policy by paying approximately Rs.750/- premium for the one-year training period.
